verdict.rationale: Honeycomb supports 'Markers' via a CLI/API (honeymarker) that lets teams CRUD markers (e.g., deploy events) on the timeline for correlation with telemetry, and Triggers/SLOs/BubbleUp can then be used to investigate regressions relative to those markers. However, the evidence pack contains only a single thin mention of the marker CLI and no detailed walkthrough of deploy/config-change tracking, no CI/CD integration examples, and no independent corroboration of this workflow in practice. missing for 10: dedicated docs/tutorial on deploy-marker correlation workflows, CI/CD integration examples, and community validation of using markers for regression-to-deploy correlation.
